properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Florida...

within Moderate flood stage through this weekend as water works north
through the basin.

forecast.

forecast.

* WHEN...Until further notice.

forecast to gradually decline the next couple days, then rise
again this weekend.

through flooded areas.
